values.note: Choice of sun or shade; 5 sites share a large parking area. Everything with wheels must fit in the spur; no overflow parking. Up to 8 people per site.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/sanjuan/recreation/miller-creek-campground ('It has 12 campsites with a choice of sun or shade and easy access to the water; 5 of the sites share a large parking area'; 'Max RV size = 45 ft'; 'Equipment with wheels (RVs, campers, cars) must fit in the parking spur. There is not any overflow parking available'), read 2026-10-28

values.note: Concrete boat ramp at the north end (Lemon Reservoir is non-motorized boating).

values.note: First-come only; arrive to claim a site and pay with recreation.gov Scan & Pay.

booking.source: https://www.recreation.gov/api/camps/campgrounds/10165460 ('This location is available on a first-come, first-served basis only. Visitors are required to physically arrive at the campground to purchase and claim a site ... Scan and Pay'), read 2026-10-28

note: Columbine RD, San Juan NF: where Miller Creek enters Lemon Reservoir on its east shore, about 16 mi up Florida Road (CR 240/243) from Durango at about 8,150 ft. Sites have easy access to the water; the shoreline recedes when the reservoir is drawn down. Upper Lemon fishing access is 1.5 mi north. --Claude
summary: FS + rec.gov: confirmed 12 FCFS sites, max RV 45 ft (agency), vault toilets, potable water, $30; added season 05-22 to 09-19 (FS 'Late May through September' + rec.gov dates). Note trimmed of field facts.
flags: Missing phone: Columbine Ranger District Office (970) 884-2512 (FS page; open Fridays only). recreation.gov's (661) 702-1420 is the concessionaire (Explorus).
Max length quoted: FS 'Max RV size = 45 ft'. Clears 23 ft.

Status: the FS page carries a 'Site Closed' banner (the 2026 season ended Sept 19). The San Juan NF Columbine road-status table (as of 2026-10-26, post-flood) lists no closure on Florida Road / CR 243; the FR 240 'North end closed' row is Ryman Creek, a different road.

Waterfront lakefront looks right on imagery: the campground sits on an open, shrubby apron sloping straight down to the reservoir shore (within ~60-100 m), with the boat ramp at the north end; FS 'easy access to the water'. Not changed.
Pin 37.40601,-107.66091 is ~160 m N of the FS coordinate 37.4046,-107.6612, inside the campground; recreation.gov has no per-site coordinates (one Scan & Pay placeholder). OK.
